=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k3 ===
- Requirement: PR title and root-cause framing — "Orchestrate judge: cap embedded PR diffs by bytes so the prompt fits codex's 1 MB stdin envelope". The failure class is line-cap-only truncation of embedded PR diffs (minified bundles with single 44-66 KB lines defeat any line cap). The poller-side review-blocked judge is an orchestrate judge whose prompt embeds a PR diff with exactly that flaw, and it is reachable by the very PR shape that caused incident #3928 (committed `dist` refresh PRs such as #4416/#4425) whenever such a PR is labelled `ai:review-blocked`.
- Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh — the review-blocked judge path: line 18690-18691 (`PR_DIFF="$(gh_retry gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${RB_PR}" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.diff' ...)"` fetches the full diff unbounded into a shell variable) and line 18953 (`head -1000 <<< "${PR_DIFF}"` inside the heredoc writing `RB_JUDGE_PROMPT_FILE` at lines 18934-18995), which is then piped directly into `codex exec` at line 19003. This inline path bypasses `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` entirely, so that script's existing `RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES` byte cap does not cover it; the new in-tree `_judge_truncate_pr_diff_file` helper plus a byte budget is the natural fix and fits the ≤10-line shape used in the wave-judge loop (fetch to tmp, 1000-line cap to a second tmp, byte-truncate via the helper, elide on failure).
- Evidence of absence: LAST RUN DIFF and the full PR DIFF contain no hunk touching lines 18689-18691 or 18953; the byte-cap helper, env vars, and budget logic live exclusively in the wave-judge block (helper at ~lines 200-236, collection loop at ~20647-20718, size/skip at ~20855-20885); the new tests cover only the wave-judge path; tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py::test_judge_pr_diff_byte_budgets_are_declared_and_consumed pins only the wave-judge sites. Verified on the current ref: line 18953 is still `head -1000 <<< "${PR_DIFF}"` with no byte bound, so 1000 lines of 44-66 KB minified-bundle content yields a prompt of tens of MB, every codex attempt at line 19003 dies with `Input exceeds the maximum length of 1048576 characters` before the model runs, and the issue sits in `ai:review-blocked` failing identically on every poll tick (warning at line 19014, "Will retry next poll cycle") — the same repeating CRITICAL-adjacent failure this PR eliminates for the wave judge, one code path over.
- SEVERITY: MAJOR
- ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k3 ===
